title: Senior Product Designer
announcement: Haut.AI is a pioneering BeautyTech startup at the forefront of personalized skincare solutions. We combine scientific research with artificial intelligence to deliver innovative solutions that actually work. Backed by leading European VCs and founded by AI scientists, we are positioned at the intersection of two explosive growth markets: AI and beauty tech. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience of our core product: an AI-powered skin analysis SaaS platform used by beauty brands, retailers, clinics, and wellness and longevity apps. What You'll Do: Own end-to-end design for the SaaS platform: discovery, user flows, prototypes and shipped UI. Design the consumer-facing skin analysis experience: capture, results, skin scores and product recommendations. It has to work across web and mobile, and stay customizable for each client’s brand. Turn complex AI and scientific output into interfaces people understand and trust. This includes the moments where the AI is uncertain or needs better input from the user, such as photo quality or lighting. Design the B2B side of the product: client dashboards and analytics, configuration and customization tools, recommendation management, and team access. Make integration easy: work with Engineering on the experience of embedding our solution into client websites and apps. Prototype fast, using AI tools to test ideas with users, clients and engineers before they reach the backlog. Run usability tests and competitive research, and back design decisions with data: product analytics, session recordings, client feedback. Evolve and maintain our design system so the team ships consistently across products and platforms. What Will Help You Thrive in This Role: 5+ years of hands-on product design experience, with a portfolio of end-to-end work that shipped on web and/or mobile. Experience designing B2B or B2B2C SaaS products, including complex dashboards, admin tools or configurable, white-label experiences. Experience designing AI-powered products, such as AI analysis, recommendation or personalization experiences. Strong command of AI tools in your own work. You use LLMs and AI design or prototyping tools (e.g. Figma AI, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Claude) to research, explore options, prototype and automate routine work, and you can show us what that changed in your output. Product thinking: you define success metrics with the PM, measure the impact of your work, and iterate based on it. Strong written and spoken English: you present your work clearly to both internal teams and clients. Highly autonomous and proactive, with a strong bias for action in fast-paced startup environments. Why Join Haut.AI ? Be part of a pioneering company revolutionizing the BeautyTech space. Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and user-centered design in beauty, with a talented, forward-thinking team. Make a tangible impact on product development and company growth. Competitive compensation based on experience and skills. Fully remote, with flexibility across UK and EU time zones. Paid PTO. Company-issued MacBook and other equipment. source_record.title: Senior Product Designer
source_record.description:
Haut.AI is a pioneering BeautyTech startup at the forefront of personalized skincare solutions. We combine scientific research with artificial intelligence to deliver innovative solutions that actually work. Backed by leading European VCs and founded by AI scientists, we are positioned at the intersection of two explosive growth markets: AI and beauty tech.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience of our core product: an AI-powered skin analysis SaaS platform used by beauty brands, retailers, clinics, and wellness and longevity apps.

What You'll Do:

  • Own end-to-end design for the SaaS platform: discovery, user flows, prototypes and shipped UI.

  • Design the consumer-facing skin analysis experience: capture, results, skin scores and product recommendations. It has to work across web and mobile, and stay customizable for each client’s brand.

  • Turn complex AI and scientific output into interfaces people understand and trust. This includes the moments where the AI is uncertain or needs better input from the user, such as photo quality or lighting.

  • Design the B2B side of the product: client dashboards and analytics, configuration and customization tools, recommendation management, and team access.

  • Make integration easy: work with Engineering on the experience of embedding our solution into client websites and apps.

  • Prototype fast, using AI tools to test ideas with users, clients and engineers before they reach the backlog.

  • Run usability tests and competitive research, and back design decisions with data: product analytics, session recordings, client feedback.

  • Evolve and maintain our design system so the team ships consistently across products and platforms.

What Will Help You Thrive in This Role:

  • 5+ years of hands-on product design experience, with a portfolio of end-to-end work that shipped on web and/or mobile.

  • Experience designing B2B or B2B2C SaaS products, including complex dashboards, admin tools or configurable, white-label experiences.

  • Experience designing AI-powered products, such as AI analysis, recommendation or personalization experiences.

  • Strong command of AI tools in your own work. You use LLMs and AI design or prototyping tools (e.g. Figma AI, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Claude) to research, explore options, prototype and automate routine work, and you can show us what that changed in your output.

  • Product thinking: you define success metrics with the PM, measure the impact of your work, and iterate based on it.

  • Strong written and spoken English: you present your work clearly to both internal teams and clients.

  • Highly autonomous and proactive, with a strong bias for action in fast-paced startup environments.

Why Join Haut.AI?

  • Be part of a pioneering company revolutionizing the BeautyTech space.

  • Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and user-centered design in beauty, with a talented, forward-thinking team.

  • Make a tangible impact on product development and company growth.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and skills.

  • Fully remote, with flexibility across UK and EU time zones.

  • Paid PTO.

  • Company-issued MacBook and other equipment.

To Apply:

Please send your CV and portfolio in English.
